en: Colorized historic postcard showing a grand civic building with red-tiled roofs, ornate façades and a tall clock tower with a green spire. The front lower part of the building bears the word "SPARKASSE" above arched windows, indicating a savings bank. At the top of the postcard appear the captions "Bilin." on the left and "Neues Rathaus." on the right, suggesting this is the new town hall of Bilin. A cobbled street and metal railing run in front of the building under a clear sky with a few clouds.
